seed: Use the life around the fight: heart demon (tâm ma) as fuel. The higher the tâm ma the stronger the build, with breakthrough and qi-deviation risk as the real price. A build that changes how the player lives between fights.
Lifespan as a resource: spend years of life for power in a fight, and earn them back by other means. A build that is a race against its own death in the world, not only in the fight.
Pill toxicity (đan độc) as power: overdose on purpose, toxicity becomes damage or defence, and the build manages the toxicity between fights. An alchemist who is their own best customer.
Built around being Downed once: the build is weak until it falls, then rises with a rewritten loadout and wins the second half. The comeback build, and what it does if the enemy kills it in one blow.
No companion, no sect, nothing attached: power for every missing piece of the social game. A wanderer build that makes the solo life a choice with teeth.

The cultivator who never loses because it never stays: escape when the fight turns, survive the world. Matters for the world simulation (who lives to Nguyên Anh). Strong at surviving, weak at killing.
Every point of the enemy's ward you break becomes your linh lực. The bigger their ward, the richer you get. A build that eats tanks and starves against a no-ward build.

Control the enemy's clock: delay their cooldowns, push their arts off the pulse, freeze their timers. A build that wins because the enemy never gets to act, and loses to builds that do not need to act (ticks, basic attacks).
Stronger the lower your health: Nghịch Cảnh-style low-life play, staying at the edge on purpose with a hard floor that keeps it alive. The PoE low-life build, and how it avoids just dying.
